anchors.name: EU AI Act Annex III 5(b): credit scoring
anchors.binding: Law in the EU: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
anchors.asks: Credit scoring and creditworthiness assessment of individuals are high-risk uses from 2 December 2027 (as amended in July 2026). Whether screening rental applications falls in scope is your call, with legal advice.
anchors.evidence: A description of each AI tool's role in decisions about people, for your legal team to classify.

anchors.name: FATF Recommendation 22: buying and selling property
anchors.binding: International standards for countries (FATF Recommendations, as amended), with risk-based guidance for the real estate sector.
anchors.asks: Businesses that act for clients in buying or selling property must identify those clients and keep records. Leasing and property management are outside it.
anchors.evidence: Registers of agreements and documents, each field linked to its page, for the staff who make the identity checks.

anchors.name: OECD Privacy Guidelines
anchors.binding: An OECD recommendation, adopted in 1980 and revised in 2013.
anchors.asks: Collection limitation, data quality, purpose specification, use limitation, security safeguards, openness, individual participation and accountability. Restrictions on cross-border data flows should be proportionate to the risk.
anchors.evidence: A deletion schedule for renter data, and a record of each deletion.
